title: Admin Directory: render leader photo as filename with click-to-open modal (no lazy loading)

requirements.text: Update the Admin Directory page so that every leader/representative photo is displayed as text (the image file name or stored photoPath string) instead of rendering any image thumbnail in the list/table view.
acceptanceCriteria: In Admin Directory list/table views, no thumbnails are rendered for representative photos; only the filename/photoPath text is shown for each entry.
The displayed text is readable and clearly indicates it is the photo reference (e.g., the stored path/filename).

requirements.text: When an admin clicks the displayed photo filename/text for a leader/representative in Admin Directory, open a modal/window overlay popup that shows the full-size photo.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a photo filename/text opens an overlay modal on top of the Admin Directory page.
The modal displays the corresponding full image and includes an obvious close control (e.g., an X button) and supports closing via ESC and clicking the backdrop.
Closing the modal returns the admin to the same scroll position/state on the Admin Directory page.

requirements.text: Ensure Admin Directory does not perform lazy-loading behavior for representative photos as part of this change (i.e., do not add intersection-observer-based image lazy-loading); only fetch/resolve the image URL when the modal is opened.

quotes: 3- no I dont want lazy loading for now.

acceptanceCriteria: No lazy-loading component/behavior is introduced for representative photos on Admin Directory.
The photo URL resolution and image load happens only after the admin clicks the filename/text to open the modal (not during initial directory render).

constraints: Do not add lazy loading for representative photos at this time.
Frontend immutable paths must not be edited (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
nonGoals: Do not change backend data models or storage formats for representative photos.
Do not redesign other admin pages or change photo behavior outside the Admin Directory page.
